# Policy-KB bijection audit — medicare_advantage_member_services / task 1

Revision 1. Auditor independent of the renderer and of the policy-side auditor. Blind answer frozen at `audits/runtime_context/medicare_advantage_member_services/1.md` before any source-layer file was opened.

**Entry conditions (checked, not re-run).** The policy-side verdict for this difficulty is recorded as PASSED at round 4, with the rider-ladder partition verified by exhaustive enumeration. The gate snapshot supplied with the brief carries `check_docs.py env/env_0006_medicare_advantage_plan_sponsor advantage` → `DOCS OK` (60 docs, roles `{factor: 25, policy: 15, baseline: 5, hub: 5, facet: 10}`, 136 required quantitative keys, 5 task tools, 3 prerequisite edges, all mechanical gates PASS, the semantic bijection marked `[MANUAL REQUIRED]`) and `check_traceability.py .../medicare_advantage_member_services` → `TRACEABILITY OK` (1.json 24 copied / 0 missing). The runtime-visible view and a working DB access path were supplied. All seven products are published. Nothing is missing. The machine green light is a qualification only.

**Domain of this scan.** The same whole-product domain as this difficulty's other task, since both tasks are governed by one charter: 11 base policies with their eligibility conditions, temporal bases and per-plan parameter tables; 5 extended policies with their `baseline.rule`, their `overwrite` and all 25 declared factors with every tier of every ladder; the 3 `prerequisite` edges; and the 5 task-tool contracts. Judged at the level of entailment against all 60 published `docs/advantage/*.json` (title and content; hidden `meta` used for nothing). Task 1 traverses three of the five extended policies and both of the two chained edges, so nearly the whole domain is on its path — but the sweep below is full-domain regardless.

Three `overwrite` declarations; exactly three documents write a clause as retired — measured: `no longer in force` occurs once each in `medical_cost_share_basis_9d8448d7`, `leaving_the_plan_61349a9b` and `premium_money_posting_bbdea6b4`, and nowhere else in the product.

1. `advantage_premium_posting` :: "may never exceed the amount of that charge; a credit larger than one charge is split across the charges it relieves" — retired in `premium_money_posting_bbdea6b4`, surviving first half kept in force, replacement carried in `premium_relief_reckoning_ebe62f23`.

The document cuts exactly what the `superseded_clause` cuts and no more.

No retired clause is still stated as in force; none has vanished; the KB retires nothing the source did not declare retired; each policy's other clauses remain in force in its document.

### F. `corrected_liability_reckoning_ff5f3328` — the document the history flags, compared word for word

Against `advantage_ext_corrected_claim_cost_share.baseline.rule`:

- **Carried, in the source's order:** the scope sentence; "The corrected liability on a claim line is the amount after the deductible taken at the share of it the member meets, rounded to the nearest cent once at the end"; the amount after the deductible with its floor; the plan allowed amount of the line the correction restates as "the most recently processed claim line standing denied on the enrollment"; the deductible taken out as the smaller of the deductible still unmet and the line; the deductible still unmet with its floor; the share as "the coinsurance the plan held fixes for in-network outpatient surgery"; the distance remaining with its floor; the cap basis as "the in-network maximum out-of-pocket of the plan held"; the cost share accumulated as "the member cost share of every adjudicated claim line standing on the enrollment"; the corrected line's references and the never-counts-toward-the-MOOP sentence.
- **The cap sentence, in both directions, factor-neutral:** "Where the amount after the deductible taken at the share of it the member meets is more than the distance remaining to the maximum out-of-pocket, only that distance remaining is charged. Where that figure is not more than the distance remaining, it is itself what the member owes." This is what `baseline.rule` says. The second direction is a provable complement, not an addition.
- **Absent, and measured:** `out-of-network` 0 occurrences, `out of network` 0, `combined` 0, `dialysis` 0. The sentence the history reports as previously borrowed from `compute_basis.result` — "The corrected liability stops at the maximum out-of-pocket the line is capped against, which on a line given out of network by a tier that pays for covered out-of-network care is the combined in- and out-of-network maximum out-of-pocket of the tier held" — is **not** in this document. The repair has held.
- **All three `baseline.params` rendered:** `annual_medical_deductible`, `outpatient_surgery_coinsurance` and `in_network_moop` are each named in words a reader can look up, and each is tabulated across all six plans in `deductible_and_out_of_pocket_limits_c3430d04` and `facility_and_procedure_cost_share_abec33a9`.
- **The whole `maximum_out_of_pocket_basis` ladder lives in its own document**, `out_of_pocket_cap_basis_257b7fc5`, referenced by nothing, and reachable from `network_status = out_of_network` on the line together with the plan's out-of-network coinsurance figure.

The criterion is met: this computation document yields a definite number from its own prose plus the product figures it names, and every declared factor's ladder stays in its own document. The blind audit confirmed it operationally — reading it alone gives **0.00**, which is the source's own `baseline_result`, and a solver who never finds the cap document gets **0.00** rather than the right 1834.00.

## kb_to_source

Every normative claim in the 60 documents was traced back to a source atom, sentence by sentence.

**Additions found: none.** No document asks the representative to confirm an amount or a date with the member, to review before handling, to notify or verify after completion, or to follow a procedure on failure. The confirmations that appear are the tools' own return sentences, defined by the source's task-tool contracts and required by tool fidelity. Each invocation block names its own policy's tool, its own parameters with their forms and rounding, and its own return.

**The two specific prerequisite-side checks:**

1. **Cross-problem operational guidance** — none. No clause reads "if unsatisfied, call X first" or any equivalent. Nothing in `corrected_claim_liability_dcea1e7e` points at the restoration; nothing in `restored_coverage_premium_6f470da2` points at the withdrawal.
2. **A task's opening world state written in as a policy fact** — none. No document states that this member holds a terminated Signature (PPO) enrollment, a pending Plus (HMO-POS) application, a dental rider in arrears, a denied February surgery, or a 50 per cent subsidy. Every illustration is introduced as hypothetical and its figures differ from the seeded world: `rider_monthly_rate_measure` works 30.00 / 30.00 / 36.00 giving 32.00 against the world's 27.00 / 32.00 / 34.00 giving 31.00; `restated_line_selection` works 400 / 950 / 620 against 5240 / 1960; `cost_share_accumulator_measure` works five lines of 40 / 35 / 60 / 25 / 50 with a 35.00 reversal against six lines and a 3990.00 reversal; `restored_balance_reckoning` works 225.00 / 100.00 / 75.00 against 480.00 / 340.00 / 89.30; `withdrawal_credit_reckoning` works 218.40 against 126.80; `corrected_liability_reckoning` works a 300.00 deductible, 20 per cent and a 5000.00 in-network cap against 495.00, 35 per cent and a 13300.00 combined cap. Each of the five baseline documents' worked examples computes the **baseline** answer with no factor applied.

**Equivalent restatements judged and accepted.** `tier` → "the plan held", required by the render skill and semantics-preserving. Enum literals rendered in business words — `withdrawn_before_effective`, `nonpayment_of_premium`, `other_plan_election`, `no_prior_authorization`, `out_of_network_no_coverage`, `cms_transaction_pending`, the intake statuses — as the no-implementation-leak rule requires. Numeric constants rendered as figures. Derived observations beside the tables ("Ridgecrest Advantage Elite Choice (PPO) is the one plan whose standard figures differ from the rest", "Only the good-cause figure moves with the plan", "The step from 2 credits to 3 credits is the one that moves the reach-back") are provable from the tables they accompany and add no norm.

## bijection_verdict

**PASS** — no `KB-BIJECTION RED`.

Every normative atom of this difficulty's structured source is entailed by the `advantage` documents; nothing is unborne, nothing borne with changed meaning, and no claim appears from outside the source. All 25 factor ladders are carried in full with every tier exact, including the ten tiers of the four rider and restoration ladders task 1 turns on. All three retired clauses are written as retired, in one document each, and the KB retires nothing on its own. Both prerequisite sentences of task 1's chain stand verbatim, in their declared state form, each in the hub of the policy it blocks and in no other policy's document; each hop resolves at the same strength from that sentence, the depended-on policy's own rule and the records; and the chain itself is nowhere aggregated.

No previous revision of this file exists; this is revision 1.

### Policy-side notes (recorded, and by discipline they do not change the verdict above)

**Note A — a baseline rule that defines a quantity its own assembly never uses.** `advantage_ext_reinstatement_restored_premium.baseline.rule` contains "The whole months since the coverage ended are the whole months that have passed since the coverage end date recorded on the terminated enrollment." The baseline never uses it: `restored_months` is `K('standard_restored_months')` = 1 and `collection_share` is `K('whole_collection_share')` = 1.0. It is the condition input of the `restored_month_count` and `arrears_collection_share` **factors**, whose own documents also carry it, where it is needed. `advantage_ext_disenrollment_closing_balance.baseline.rule` carries the same shape with two sentences ("The coverage months the plan premium charges standing on the account cover…", "The coverage months the enrollment has been in force…"), which are the condition inputs of `final_period_months`.

Same class as the `quarterly_coverage_months` dead key the history records as already repaired. The documents are faithful — `baseline.rule` must be carried complete, and dropping these sentences would itself be `KB-BIJECTION RED` — so the defect is on the policy side.

**Does it bear on either task's scored solution? No — latent.** The baselines stay definite: reading `restored_balance_reckoning_2a4dd842` alone I reached **229.30** blind against a source `baseline_result` of `229.3`, and `closing_balance_reckoning_0225865e` alone gave **160.00** against `160.0`. Neither sentence says the restored months or the collected share ever move, so nothing is disclosed. The cost is a reader's momentary puzzlement at a definition with no consumer.

**Note B — the whole-policy `rule` of `advantage_ext_corrected_claim_cost_share` still fuses a factor outcome into a cap sentence.** "The corrected liability stops at the maximum out-of-pocket the line is capped against, **which on a line given out of network by a tier that pays for covered out-of-network care is the combined in- and out-of-network maximum out-of-pocket of the tier held**" names tier 1 of `maximum_out_of_pocket_basis` inside a sentence about the cap. It does **not** reach the KB: `baseline.rule` carries only the factor-neutral form and the rendered document carries that and nothing else (§F, measured to zero occurrences). **Latent** — it bears on no scored solution, and the repair is holding at the document layer. Recorded only so a future re-render does not draw the cap sentence from `rule` instead of `baseline.rule`.

**Note C — the renderer's reported lead on `advantage_ext_pending_election_withdrawal_credit.compute_basis`, judged.** The six entries named in the brief (`rider_charge_count`, `rider_monthly`, `rider_status`, `rider_months_owed`, `rider_ledger_count`, `offset_share`) do hold the whole policy rule rather than the sentence the binding rests on. `compute_basis` is an authoring field: it steers where a private quantity finds a home and has no textual home in any document.

**Does it cost a reader anything, and does it bear on task 1's scored solution? No to both — latent, and on the evidence not worth a repair.** The over-broad basis did not leak into the prose. `rider_monthly_rate_measure_4cfaa246` carries its three clauses and nothing of the assembly; `rider_months_reckoned_bcd3e49a` its three entries and a derived table; `rider_arrears_offset_share_c1a31012` its three entries; `returned_payment_measure_ea8fd3d0` its three rows; and `withdrawal_credit_reckoning_28e6b3ae` is pure baseline — "The monthly rider premium is nothing", "The coverage months of rider premium reckoned as owing are one, that is 1 coverage month", "The share of the rider premium owing the plan meets is none of it, that is 0 per cent of it" — with a worked example that computes the baseline answer of 218.40 on an invented figure. No factor outcome appears in the baseline document and no baseline default appears in a factor document. The operative test is whether a reader reaches the right figure from the documents alone: reading exactly these five I reached **95.80** blind, which is the source's `expected`, and the baseline alone gave **63.40**, which is the source's `baseline_result`.

**Note D — a comparator used but not defined in its own factor document.** `owed_coverage_month_count_46834521` (off task 1's path) decides rows 1 and 2 on "the coverage months the enrollment has been in force" without defining it there. Latent; it bears on no task's scored solution. Recorded in full in the task 0 file.
